reviews.text: Hard to reach via phone but in person service is efficient.
one of the most affordable vets in LA and they know what theyre doing! rebecca and the boy with blue hair are super kind!! :)
The team were incredible taking care of my elderly cat after she had a seizure. They were super thorough and on top of it. Pricing was wild so definitely be ready to spend a couple thousand.
We’re grateful for your 5-star rating! It's great to know you had a pleasant experience. We hope to see you and your pet again soon!
We appreciate the 5-star review! It's great to know you had a wonderful visit. Hope to welcome you and your pet back at our clinic soon!
Amazing experience during my first time here. Feel like my fur baby and I are in good hands. It’s inexpensive and you are taken care of.

Very caring
Works to give least meds possible
I love this place! Parking can be an issue, and there can be long waits, even with an appointment. But that’s bc they treat emergencies, and I love them for it. And the quality of care is top notch
Dr Baum is a Rockstar! All of the staff are amazing and caring people! My fur babies have been going to Center Sinai since 1999!
Very kind doctor and staff. Thank you so much for helping our little Luna and her emergency ! Will be back if we ever need care again but hopefully not!
Center Sinai Animal Hospital has been caring for my dogs for over 5o years.  Great doctors and staff at the best animal hospital here and abroad.

Set up an appointment with Dr. Braum for an issue with my leopard gecko. It ended up being an impacted sperm plug, and the doctor promptly removed it, applied antibiotics, and thoroughly explained everything to me. It was easy & quick, the doctor was a great guy, very friendly and attentive even when it seemed like a busy afternoon. The front desk staff was wonderful too! The cost was very fair as I didn’t know what to expect for a small exotic pet. You never know what you’re gonna get these days with both service and cost, so it was a huge relief for both me and my gecko :) Thanks guys!

AVOID DR ANDREA ZANETTI AT ALL COSTS. HE IS TERRIBLE! When he entered the room, he did not even have the human courtesy to look at me or my boyfriend in the eyes or greet us. As we were explaining our concerns, it was clear he was not listening and did not care as he simply did not respond and just talked over us. While taking our pet out of the crate, he handled her so unnecessarily and pulled her face back until her eyes basically popped out. I have never seen anyone handle a pet so aggressively. Especially strange because she wasn’t being difficult or anything. So there was no need for that.
Lastly, since he didn’t listen to any of our concerns, he misdiagnosed our cat and recommended incorrect, unnecessary, and EXPENSIVE labs. Overall, he was cold, demeaning, and did not provide a standard of care that I would recommend to any pet or human. My cat even soiled herself in the carrier from how traumatized she was. She has never done this before. And another note, he kept calling our cat “FAT” when she is just slightly overweight. Look up any reviews on dr Andrea Zanetti, and you’ll see he has an obsession for calling animals FAT. Even other pet parents in the waiting room couldn’t believe how cold and arrogant he was.  Anyone that employees someone like that, should NOT be in business.

Absolute five stars!! I was actually thinking about this as I left my last visit. Center-Sinai is such a sweet, special place. It’s bety clean, but it doesn’t have that cold, ultra-modern clinical feeling that can make you feel detached when you’re there worrying about your pet. It feels warm and human instead.

I know that’s a funny place to start a veterinary review, but it genuinely means something to me. They even have a memorial for one of their staff members painted on the wall outside, surrounded by paw prints, which I find heartwarming. There is just a feeling of love and care here.

Dr. Gamez was generous with his time me, at the same with all the doctors. I never ever feel like they’re in a rush: thoughtful, thorough, kind, and incredibly fair pricing. I felt like he genuinely cared about my cats rather than looking for ways to add unnecessary expenses.

Center-Sinai functions exactly the way I think a veterinarian should ❤️🐾
We appreciate the 5-star rating, Ellen! It's fantastic to know you had a positive experience. We hope to see you and your pet again soon!

I'm really glad that I was able to get care for my pet turtle Wilma in the couple times I had some issues that were happening. As an exotic pet owner, the hours are very convenient for me to come & find a vet to that gives great care coming from LA. I'm very thankful recently for Dr. Baum, for really helping me out when I could tell my turtle was acting abnormal coming back from vacation. I knew it was something internal. Regardless the prices for the X-rays, it was very needed to find the solution. I did a follow up the week after sharing what has happened since then & he gave my turtle a calcium shot, which was really needed because all the eggs in her were not coming out. She was also losing her appetite, and it seemed like where I left her to be taken care of she wasn't able to lay the eggs. If you're a pet owner and have female turtles, you know, this is a very serious situation that really needs to be taken care of soon when it comes to egg binding. Now close to 2 weeks after the follow up, she has her appetite back, and acting like herself again. I'm glad Dr. Baum answered my questions regarding white spots on her shell mentioning it to be early signs of shell rot which is still treatable at home & affordable. Now I can focus on treating Wilma's shell rot. I'm really thankful for the staff at Center Sinai for the help & care for me & especially my pet since childhood.
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Roxanne! We're happy to know you enjoyed your experience. We can't wait to see you and your pet again!
Everyone is so nice!
Dr Gamez is an outstanding professional. So lucky to have him care for our pets. He is just amazing
Thanks for the top rating, Adam! We're happy to have met your expectations.
Dr. Baum is the Bomb 😊 …
I wasn't impressed. I didn't feel that I was taken serious by the vets in my concerns and the wait time was longer than expected. The techs were not very accommodating either.
The service my pet received from the team was very good.
Always a good experience

I brought my cat to Center Sinai after confirming by phone that they could do an ultrasound. The clinic was clean, the front desk staff were kind, and the first doctor I met was great. Unfortunately, almost everything involving the ultrasound was mishandled.

Even though I confirmed availability the day before, I was told the tech wouldn’t be in until Monday. Then the appointment was moved to Tuesday because the tech was on vacation. The day before the scan, I was told for the first time that they only offer a quick scan, not a full one, with no explanation or apology for the repeated miscommunication.

I also wasn’t told my cat needed an empty stomach until the morning of the scan. When I arrived for my confirmed 8 a.m. appointment, staff insisted I didn’t have one until I showed them the text. Again, no apology. The doctor seemed annoyed and tried to talk me out of the scan, but eventually agreed. Once the scan was completed, she actually gave me extremely helpful suggestions on next steps — more helpful than any doctor up to that point — and I appreciated that.

The scan showed there were no blockages, which was valuable information and allowed us to try other approaches before considering a more invasive and costly biopsy, which the doctor was trying to inform me about so I had all of the information.

Despite that, the entire process caused unnecessary stress during an already difficult situation. I even apologized to the doctor at the end to keep things positive, though I felt they should have apologized for the miscommunication and lack of accountability. I genuinely liked the male doctor and the front desk staff, and once the plan was set, I thought everything was finally resolved.

Unfortunately, when I left, I found feces on the outside of my carrier in a zipped area that my cat cannot access — and it wasn’t her stool. I know it wasn't hers because she has chronic diarrhea and the color and thickness is completely different. A human would have had to place it there as it was in a separate zipped area. After all the miscommunication, stress, and that final incident, I cannot return. If they contact me with a sincere apology and credit at the least, I might consider giving them another chance, but I’m not holding my breath. If a place will leave feces in a pets carrier just for spite or whatever, who knows what else they would do to my sweet cat.

P.S. I also called in to let them know about the feces and I heard laughing from the staff in the background.
Thank you for the review, Lucresha! :)

Dr. Baum is such a caring and understanding vet. He explains everything well and truly loves all the pets who come to see him. We came to him through a referral many years ago. The staff is also helpful and friendly.

Ive been coming for 3 years and most of the time I get good service on the phone but today a lady named B..she was rude,  I spend alot of money on my pets, the last thing I want to hear  is someone like her.
Unprofessional techs could barely explain the after care instructions, had to go back because they forgot to give her a cone after being spayed. Highly recommend taking your pet somewhere else.
Thank you for the review, Adriana! :)
Great Vets in the same location that I adopted My Dog!
Dr Baum is terrific!
PetDesk App was easy and great to schedule appointment. Staff and Dr were attentive and processed us in timely manner.
Bad experience, called in to take my dog as walk in. When I got there was turned back around with my sick dog.

For the past 15 years, they not only cared for our three furry companions but also showered them with love—even going so far as to save the life of one of them. Dr. Gamez is an excellent professional and an even better human being.
Everyone at Center Sinai is friendly and responsive to our concerns. Great place!
We love Dr. Baum and his expertise. He and his staff are caring and professional. We have been coming to him and the practice for a while and are very satisfied every visit.
Dr. Castillo was so much more caring and detailed than any other vet I’ve been to in years. This place is always amazing, the wait is short and I recommend it so highly

Out of all the animal hospitals I’ve been to and I’ve been to 4 recently for the same problem they were the only ones that didn’t just try to get rid of me assuming I couldn’t pay for it. Which I can understand  most people probably can’t afford to pay for the procedures to keep our dogs a healthy. Even minor ones. But there just doesn’t seem to be a lot of desire to help the dogs unless they know you can cover the bill. Which is the same as human drs so it is what is

It is a very busy clinic so the wait time can be pretty long.  But, for me and my pooch, it has been worth it.
Thank you for the review, Bruce! :)

I have been with Center Sinai Animal Hospital for 5-6 yrs. The doctors and staff are all respectful, caring, kind and patience with all pets & owners. I would recommend Center Sinai Animal Hospital to anyone who needs a very good animal hospital.

Just really happy with the way my questions and concerns were answered. My dog Harper is anxious reactive especially around new people and for a first visit I was so impressed of the lack of fear to meet her needs and the care and advice that was shown was not what we have experienced before. This clinic came very highly recommended to me and I absolutely see why.
Thank you for the paw-some rating, Tania!

Every time I have been here it has been a positive experience.  The staff is helpful and friendly. The ease of booking appointments online and the fact that they have multiple doctors makes it very convenient. My dog Taco recently had his first dental with Center Sinai Animal Hospital and it was a stressless experience. Dropped him of at 9:30/10am. They called shortly after letting me know his blood work was good. After his dental they called me to let me know everything went well and I picked him up at 5pm. They even called the next day to see how he was doing and if I had any questions. Really appreciate this place. Thank you.

I recommend you all to everyone I know with cats and dogs. You all have been far better than my previous vet in so many ways. Here Kiwi and myself feels like we are treated well, and cared for appropriately. Your hours are phenomenal, and all the vets here that we have seen were very kind. Dr. Quel, and Dr. Castillo have seen Kiwi for separate issues, and they were both wonderful. Keep it up! Cat Tax photo of Kiwi waiting to be seen by Dr. Castillo for her cherry eye situation this past Wednesday.
I have been taking my cat here for a couple of years.  My Tuxie cat has fatty liver disease  and I really appreciate the care and expertise from both Dr Quel and Dr Williams.
Osvaldo, we are grateful you took the time to leave a review. Thank you for trusting us with your pet’s care!
This is a great vet clinic with a very nice staff. I bring my 3 cats and two dogs here all the time, and they are very nice, capable, and I love how well they communicate. 10 out of 10.
Great vet. Been going to Center Sinai for at least 30 years and they are always friendly, kind and gentle with my cats, and very knowledgeable.
We are so grateful for your support and for taking the time to leave a review! It's always our goal to provide a positive experience for both you and your pet.

I highly recommend Dr. Christina Quel.  I was going on a trip and brought in my 21 month Shih-Tzu  to be spayed. Dr. Quel expedited the surgery and came in early to do the procedure the next day to ensure my Shih-Tzu  was fully recovered by the time I left on my trip. This was the smoothest spay any of my pets has undergone.  My dog was calmly wagging her tail when I picked her up.  She was wearing a pink bandage adorned with Purple Hearts on her little paw where the IV had been placed.  I was sent home with liquid pain medication.  It has been 2 days since the spay and my dog is very comfortable and playful.  Thank you so much Dr. Quel.  The entire staff at Center Sinai works as a coordinated team to provide pets with the best possible care.

Why bother?

Took my dog here for 6 years, but their recent policies and lack of care made me look elsewhere. They no longer allow prescriptions to be filled at sites like Chewy over the phone forcing you to come in and get a written prescription. If your dog hasn’t been seen in a year you’re forced to get an exam for $96, at the time of writing, which is about 1/3 higher than places two miles away charging $63.

Then if you do make an appointment, you often won’t be seen for a good hour past the appointment time and you’ll probably hear vets like Dr Gamez talking about how they “need to take their break” while you’re sitting there in the hot, waiting room.

This place has devolved into something else entirely over the past few years and they lost another customer today.
Thank you so much, Cathy, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We're genuinely pleased to hear that you had a positive experience with us. Your feedback means a lot to us!

Center sinai animal hospital is the very best place to take your pets. I have used them for many years. They have always provided very carrying professional help and are always available to answer my leaving you a review questions. In my experience they're the very best!!!
They always resolve the problems with the best team, they are friendly and always have the best prices. Doctors are incredibly and professionals.
I have been going to Center Sinai Animal Hospital for several years. They have always taken good care of my animals. Front office staff are great and Grooming also does a great job. Great doctors!
Do yourself a favor and pick a more communicative and professional vet office. Not cheap either.
This review made our day, Maria. Thank you!

Dr Baum and Stacey P. were both very nice and very sweet with my dog.

I’ve been bringing my dogs here for many years. The people are extremely friendly and Dr Baum is the best. I even get the dogs groomed here and the groomers are so sweet and caring. Highly recommend this place.

I can only base this on my visit for our MOUSE. While Dr. Baum may be competent and qualified to work on other animals, his handling of our mouse was a complete mistake. This was an older mouse and never should have received an injection considering her age and stress levels. He then missed on the first injection while holding her upside down by her tail with one hand and the needle in the other, so essentially jabbing her with a needle in the back, then tried a second time when my daughter held the mouse and claims that he did sub-cutaneous, which means you lift the skin and inject under the skin, not intramuscular and definitely not jabbing the mouse in the rear abdomen, which is likely what happened. I was right there, that was not sub-cutaneous. Our mouse went into seizure and immediately had a heart attack and dies in front of us in my daughter’s hands. All the mouse needed was a dip to improve her itchiness with mites. I expressed my anger in private and Dr. Baum told me told me he would correct this and take classes to learn to do injections on rodents correctly and to learn from his mistake. I am now holding you accountable. Don’t over estimate your abilities. Slow down! Get assistance first on small animal when doing an injection! Advise your client correctly regarding the possible outcomes of a procedure! Assess the situation correctly when working with elderly population regarding what treatments are correct and needed! And finally if you make a mistake, correct it, take the class, get the instruction. Don’t let it happen again!

seemed very competent went with a friend to take his dog in for shots. Also did not appear to over charge for shots. They were rather slow about cleaning up the waiting room for dog urine which could have caused a slip and fall injury, but hey that's their problem.

My PomChi has been going to Center Sinai for over 10 years. The service there was fantastic. The team really love and are devoted to animals. They get very overwhelmed w clients so try to be patient when you call or show up to an appointment. The place is busy bc it’s hard to find a clinic that prioritizes your pet’s wellbeing like this one. Dr. Gamez has been treating my Homer for years and is always helpful and thorough. Def recommend getting the WellCare also. It will save you in the long run.

My pets and I have been coming to Center Sinai Animal Hospital for 13 years. The the front staff has always been very friendly and they always seem to recognize me. All the doctors I have seen are very caring & loving with my pets and have always shown exceptional professionalism & are very good at listening to my concerns when it comes to my pets.

The staff is very rude and speaks to people in a belittling way, especially the woman with the very short hair who is always at the front. She’s rude when you walk in and just as rude when answering the phone. If she dislikes her job that much, maybe it’s time for her to look elsewhere, because she always seems miserable—and it shows in how she responds to people both in person and over the phone.
Dr Castillo was awful. If you don’t like your job just quit. Terrible experience, every interaction besides the front desk staff was terrible.
Dr. Baum was compassionate and gentle while providing our 8-week old puppy with her first wellness exam. The staff were attentive and kind.  Our appointment took place punctually.
Rude.
I love this veteranarian hospital,  open weekends, friendly and knowledgeable staff. Brought my Frenchie in for vaccinations and ear infection. Done within 2 hours. Reasonably priced!🙂
Took excellent care of my baby Georgie. She’s so tiny. They put her to sleep and her teeth are so white and so impressed and this is a picture of her riding home.

Thank you, Mike, for your positive feedback. Your support means a lot to us, and we are committed to providing you with consistent and dependable service in the future. We look forward to serving you again!

Everyone at the hospital took such great care of my dog Chase, this has been his primary hospital/clinic for years now and I wouldn’t change a thing. From his grooming appointments to his regular check up the staff never fails to take care of him. I recommend this hospital to anyone that sees this !!
Thank you for the review, Victor! :)

Money-sucking petri-dish!!! If you want your pet to catch a disease or for a vet staff or doctors to literally not care about anything except filling up their own pockets, by all means, come here! Have been here 6 times last 6 months with my dog and I’m never coming back. Stay away!!!!!

I brought my dog to Center Sinai Vet on Venice for an emergency after he was attacked by another dog. I called ahead, described his injuries, and was explicitly told to come in because they could help him.

We waited over 3 hours before being taken into a room. Once inside, the vet walked in with a cold, dismissive attitude and without even looking at my dog said she couldn’t see him because he would need surgery and she “didn’t have time before closing.” They close at 9pm — this was around 7:30pm, after we had already waited hours.

After refusing to see him, she changed her mind and said she could look at him. I calmly explained that my dog would need to be muzzled for safety, and that I had brought his muzzle, which he is trained to wear. She became frustrated and again refused to examine him. She then changed her mind again, left the room with the door open, and loudly yelled down the hallway, “Can anyone help me hold a dog down? You’re definitely going to get bit.” This was incredibly unprofessional and stressful.

She returned with a vet tech and attempted to tie my dog’s mouth shut with gauze instead of using the muzzle I provided. Ultimately, the vet again decided she would not examine him and stated he would need surgery. I was told I could either spend thousands at an emergency vet that night or go home with pain meds and antibiotics and return in the morning for surgery.

I then waited over an hour for medication and an invoice, which was incorrect and included services that were never provided.

The vet never examined my dog, showed no empathy, and the entire experience felt chaotic, dismissive, and unsafe. We chose not to return the next morning and instead went to a different emergency/urgent care, where my dog was treated appropriately.

Had I been told honestly that they could not support an emergency dog attack case, I never would have brought my dog here. This was a heartbreaking and frustrating experience during an already traumatic situation. I would not recommend this clinic.

The people here were really compassionate and nice! THANK U ALL for helping our cat with her pyometra surgery we are very grateful😸The place is really nice and the people there are very experienced, and they would call us to keep us updated on how our cat was doing. …

I was looking for a vet that would be able to help me with health certificate for my travel to Europe with my dog. Center Sinai was recommended to me and I will forever be grateful. They are absolutely amazing- everyone starting with the front desk ladies, the vet associates, the doctors, every single person is fantastic. This whole process of getting all the documents to fly with your pet is very stressful but the CS team help you feel at ease and they do an excellent job. Thank you so much for your help! Moon, my husband and I had an absolute blast during our Christmas break in Europe ♥️!

All of the doctors take their time to explain the treatment options and worked with you to make decisions about your pet. The front staff are so friendly and always helpful! Most importantly, my dog Kayleigh loves going to Center Sinai!

The entire staff at center Sinai is kind and caring. I’ve taken my dog here for years- through surgeries, for grooming, and normal vet needs. Dr. Gamez is the best kind of vet- he gives thorough explanations while still being patient and understanding. The wait can be long at times- but I wouldn’t trust any other practice with my dog!
Thank you for the review, Roxy! :)

Was seen very quickly everyone to the intake nurse to the doctor were very helpful all pricing is up front and have to pay out of pocket, they don't take insurance, but will help with the reimbursement steps if you have a policy.
Staff is great!  Easy walk-in tech visit for allergy shot.

Not the same without Dr. Oliver…Don’t try to call because you’ll wait on hold forever and sometimes it’ll just end your call after waiting on hold without even getting to talk to anyone. When they finally answer you’re treated like crap or they act like you’re stupid and don’t know what you’re talking about. Then will tell you they’ll have a “vet” call you back, only to be texted by a front office tech about something unrelated hours later. My advice is to find a better vet. It will save you a lot of time and frustration.

To whom it may concern,  I would like to express my heartfelt appreciation for the outstanding care provided by Center Sinai Animal Hospital.  In both 2923 and 2025, my dogs were treated  for cancer, and during those difficult times, the staff demonstrated remarkable  compassion, respect, and professionalism.

Every member of the team was loving  and attentive, creating and environment where my pets felt safe and cared for.  Their dedication and kindness made a challenging experience  more bearable, and I am truly grateful  for the comfort they provided to both my dogs and family.

Center Sinai Animal Hospital is a place where animals are treated with genuine care and dignity, and I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone seeking exceptional veterinary services.

Sincerely, Julia
My Louie anxiety issues have gotten worse since my other dog passed. They have been so understanding, and I truly appreciate it 💗 …

My dog has been going here since she was a puppy. They love pets! They have great hours 7 days a week.
Dr. Gamez and Williams are caring and compassionate.
The front office staff is helpful and supportive.
The techs are caring.

I have been to a couple other vets closer to where I live and their bedside manner was questionable and obviously focused on how much money they could swindle.
This Pet hospital/vet is amazing. All of their Dr's have been so kind and very patient. My pup just got diagnosed with inoperable cancer on 11/23/25. 😭 The way Dr Gamez broke it down to me in such a caring way and not like my pup was just another number, meant so so much. They have also seen my little kitty recently and have been just as kind. She also has a biopsy pending. I have so much trust in this place and their Dr's and staff work so so hard while staying so empathetic and kind. I highly recommend this hospital. Dr Gamez and Dr Baum have been amazing. ❤️😢😭🙏 Pup is Elvis and kitty is Kisses. They are in the pics shared here  😢🐈😿😽🐶🐾
Best service saved 2 fur babies

We’ve had good care at several vets. But Santi usually creates (negative) associations with the place. Except for Center Sinai. He’s been fine over several visits. Always walking in and to the back without anxiety. Happy to have Center Sinai for Santi’s care.
The staff and doctors are all very kind and helpful

Wish I never went here. Short story is my best friend has passed and if I had gotten competent care he could have lived a longer healthy life. Ask your vet for a blood test. Get one even if they say it's not necessary.
Take good care of your family pets and don't count on them.

I strongly advise everyone to stay away from Center Sinai Animal Hospital.

The male veterinarian who treated my pet was extremely rude, arrogant, and condescending. He made me feel completely disrespected and even discriminated against.

He pushed me toward a treatment plan that would have cost around $1,000, insisting it was urgent and necessary. When I took my pet to another clinic for a second opinion, they confirmed that the entire plan was completely unnecessary and borderline unethical. My pet received the right care elsewhere for a much lower price.

It’s clear that this place cares more about money than the animals they claim to help.

If you truly care about your pet’s health and dignity, avoid this hospital at all costs.
Nicest staff and Dr. Baum is amazing!

I've visited the hospital twice (once for pretty serious oral surgery on one of my pets) and both times I was impressed by the kindness and communication from doctors and staff. Thank you for caring so much about my pets. :)

I have brought 3 of my guinea pigs here and I have always been greeted and treated very kindly here. I previously went to a different hospital but have checked Center-Sinai out as it’s closer. The previous doctor that assisted my guinea pigs here retired, however I am happy to have Dr.Baum as my guinea pig’s veterinarian. Very kind, knowledgeable, and hands on. The staff is incredibly kind and helpful. I apologize as I should have asked for their names, but each and everyone one is kind and knowledgeable. I work at a veterinary hospital myself so I know the importance of table side manners and this hospital definitely has them. I am glad I have a new veterinary hospital I trust for my pets :)
Dr. Baum is Avery kind and experienced vet.Terri in the front office takes great care of us at all times.

We are so happy to have found Center Sinai Animal Hospital because here our dog is treated like family. We trust that the Care she receives here is the Care we want for her. Other companies are in it for the money, but here at Cedar Sinai Animal Hospital you can rest assured that your pet is part of a family and they care for more than just the bill, they care for you beloved four-legged family member. Highly recommend.

Center Sinai has been a life saver for my family. At least for my pets. They are up front about the cost, and in my opinion very reasonable. They are professional and polite. I recommend that everyone brings their pets to them.

For the past three years Center Sinai and their doctors and staff have been wonderful for my cat. From the front desk kindness and patience to the caring nurses to the expert DVM. Also very good at calling back on the phone. Short wait times at appointment. Clean and well lit exam rooms. Also want to express gratitude at how professional and efficient they were at filling the paperwork with the USDA for pet travel. They deserve more than 5 stars!
Dr Gamez is fabulous!

My cat’s doctor made the session to easy and stress free. She quickly assessed the problem and issued the adequate treatment. We have come here in the past and will continue return.

I like Center Sinai. I think Dr.Oliver is a kind woman. They’re just expensive and NEVERRRRRRRR answer the phone. However, I did refer my family here so they bring their dog here too.

Our husky desperately needed a fresh start on grooming. Her undercoat was very thick and compacted and she does not do well with brushing despite trying everything to desensitize her. The grooming staff spent hours brushing her out while sedated and were able to restore her coat without shaving her down. She feels like a totally new dog, and we are so grateful. The expense was so worth it.
Amazing service and great help. Was on a very tight schedule and CSAH helped me tremendously. The team was incredible and super kind. Couldn't recommend CSAH enough!!

Great! They don’t up-sale. They are skilled and caring. The front staff always are kind and the vets are top notch.
Thank you so much, Sandra, for your wonderful 5-star rating! Your support brings us joy, and we’re thrilled to hear that you had such a positive experience.

I brought my chihuahua in for her 3-year rabies shot, and once I arrived, I was told she was also due for her parvo and bordetella vaccines. They asked if I wanted to take care of all three at once, and I agreed, since I figured it was best to get them done. They took her to the back for the shots and a nail trim.

When they returned her, I was told only 2 of the 3 shots were given and that I’d need to bring her back next week for the third. I didn’t think much of it, paid the bill, and went home. A couple of hours later, her snout started swelling and her eyes turned red. I immediately called the vet, explained what was happening, and was told, “She’s having a vaccine reaction. Bring her in now.”

I rushed back, and they gave her a Benadryl shot and kept her for observation. While waiting, I looked up vaccine reactions and learned that small dogs are more likely to have adverse effects when multiple vaccines are administered at once. I was never warned of this risk beforehand because if I had known, I never would have agreed to all the shots on the same day.

When I went to pick her up, I was handed another $89 bill for the Benadryl shot. I expressed my concern, as I felt I shouldn’t be charged for treatment related to a reaction I wasn’t warned about. Their response? That she was “supposed to have 3 shots but the doctor decided to only do 2 today” and that “it could have been a bee sting.” In other words, they admitted the doctor knew a reaction was possible but didn’t tell me, and then tried to downplay it.

This feels like shady and irresponsible practice. Thankfully, my dog is okay now, but this could have been much worse. I will not be returning.

This is by far the hardest review I will ever have to write. My baby girl, only 4 years old, died due to a traumatic misdiagnosis and complete mishandling by this vet.
They assured me she was “stable and healthy enough” to transfer to a 24-hour emergency hospital. Just 8 minutes into the car ride, she stopped breathing in my arms. The ER doctors at VCA West LA did everything possible—performing CPR three times—but we had to let her go.
The reality is their neglect, poor judgment, and failure to act led to her suffering and ultimately cost her life. What makes this even harder is that I trusted them to know best and to put my sweet girl’s care first. Instead, their initial misdiagnosis made her worse, and when she declined rapidly, they failed her again.
She was the kindest, most gentle soul—funny, silly, playful, and the light of my life. To lose her at only 4 years old in such a horrible way is something I’ll never be able to fully process. I can finally look at photos and videos of her now without complete collapse, but the pain will never leave me.
I share this because I don’t want other pet parents to go through what I did. Please, take the time to deeply research your veterinarian and be aware of changes in ownership or priorities. I thought my vet was trustworthy, but when a corporate takeover shifted values toward profit instead of care, my baby girl paid the ultimate price.
I miss her every single day. She will always be my baby, my best friend, and my angel.
